RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men. An all-male panel selecting one male applicant over another does not indicate sex discrimination against you, as sex was not a differentiating factor between the two of you.

While an entirely male panel may reflect broader diversity issues within the bank's leadership, raising it regarding your specific outcome would appear unfounded and undermine your credibility. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up regarding your request for feedback. The announcement highlights "broad experience of regulatory affairs," suggesting the panel prioritized compliance experience and stakeholder management over quantitative depth for this leadership role. Focus your inquiries on qualifications and skill alignment.
